parts.content:
A disc is **stable** if it can **never be flipped again**, no matter what moves happen.

- **Interior discs are harder**: they’re stable only if they’re protected in every direction — horizontal, vertical, and both diagonals — usually by edges/corners/stable discs.

Simple question to ask:  
**“Could White ever get one white disc on one side of this black disc and play/own another white disc on the other side in a line?”**  
If yes, it might still flip. If no in every direction, it’s stable.
